text:
tom: Heads-up: scheduled deploy in 10m (change window 14:00 PT). Deploying query-service v6.1.0. Plan: enable feature flag `ff_smart_autocomplete_v2` with a staggered ramp (12% -> 36% -> 75% -> 100%) and pin model routing to prod-v2.0 for 1h as a safety. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/v6.1.0 (please review). Any objections?

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 2024-09-02T14:00:00PT. Canary batch = 6 instances. Ramp plan: 12% @t+2m, 36% @t+9m, 75% @t+20m, 100% @t+35m. Auto-pause triggers: p99 latency > 250ms for 5m OR 5xx rate > 0.5% for 4m OR cache_hit_ratio drop >7% for 6m. Will report step health.

nisha: I'll own SLO watch. Add a downstream saturation gate: if downstream qps increases >15% sustained for 5m, pause. Also include trace sampling bump to 1000/s for the first 30m after each ramp step.

charlie: Infra note: pinning to prod-v2.0 will keep routing stable. ops-oncall has keys to unpin. Please include quick rollback snippets in the thread.

deploy-bot: Operator rollback snippet:
```
# immediate rollback operator steps
redwoodctl ff set ff_smart_autocomplete_v2 off --reason "rollback: safety gate"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v2.0 --duration 60m
# optional: scale down new pods
kubectl scale deployment query-service --replicas=20 -n prod
```

tom: Added to runbook: if automated pause fires, pause ramp, collect top 10 error traces, notify #incidents, decision to resume or rollback within 15m. Also mention to Product that the pinned routing will be held for 60m.

deploy-bot: Canary at 12% stable @t+4m. Proceeding to 36% now.

nisha: small p95 jitter at t+8m but not sustained. Holding.

deploy-bot: Reached 36% @t+10m. Increasing traces sampling.

oncall: Seeing a cache hit dip on one region at t+12m (-6.5%) but below pause threshold. Watching.

charlie: Noted one node OOM spike on a canary pod at t+15m but it restarted and recovered. No widespread effect.

deploy-bot: Proceeding to 75% @t+21m. Holding 10m.

nisha: p99 touched 255ms at t+24m for 3m window; not yet 5m sustained. No pause.

oncall: QPS downstream stable. No routing anomalies.

deploy-bot: At t+29m automated pause fired (cache_hit_ratio drop = 8.2% over 6m). Ramp paused at 75%.

tom: Runbook step executed: pause confirmed. Collecting traces and logs. Tagging @product and @mobile.

charlie: Investigating infra side - looks like a CDN edge config change coincident with ramp. This is external; recommend we rollback FF to stop additional downstream pressure while CDN fix rolls out.

nisha: Agreed. Rollback to 0 and pin model for safety. Execute when ready.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback now per operator instruction.

# actions taken
redwoodctl ff set ff_smart_autocomplete_v2 off --reason "rollback: cache hit drop due to CDN edge"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v2.0 --duration 60m

charlie: CDN team notified and rolling back their edge change. Monitoring cache hit as they revert.

oncall: After CDN revert, cache hit ratio back to baseline at t+52m. Recommend we keep feature disabled and schedule a follow-up dry-run once CDN change is stable.

tom: Will file a follow-up ticket and schedule a small-canary re-test next week. Release notes updated: noting rollback, rationale, and next steps.

doc-admin: Updated release doc and runbook with incident summary and rollback commands. Closing this thread for post-deploy follow-ups; reopen if anything else crops up.
